steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to Agent Hub in Tab A and click the "My Liked" filter chip
Step 2 — Verify the current "My Liked" list is displayed in Tab A
Step 3 — Open Agent Hub in Tab B (new tab, same browser context)
Step 4 — In Tab B, locate an unliked agent and click its heart icon (like)
Step 5 — Verify the like count increments on the agent card in Tab B
Side-channel check — known defect #1215 console error on the Tab B like click (checked here, after step 5's own wait, so the async dispatch that triggers it has definitely already landed)
Step 6 — Switch back to Browser Tab A
Step 7 — Verify the newly liked agent is NOT yet visible in Tab A's "My Liked" list

Step 8 — Reload Tab A (substituted for the case text's non-existent "reload icon" — CLARIFICATION, cited EliteaAI/elitea-testing-public#1212, not re-filed) and verify the "My Liked" list refreshes (Step 9)
Step 10 — Verify the agent liked in Tab B now appears in Tab A's "My Liked" list
Step 11 — Verify the like count on the newly appeared card matches Tab B's count
Cleanup — unlike the agent (in Tab B) to restore the pre-test baseline

links.name: Known defect — non-serializable console error on like/unlike click
